command:
rm -f packages/core/reports/mutation/fixture.json \
&& pnpm --filter @seen/core test:fixtures \
&& pnpm --filter @seen/core mutation:fixture \
&& python3 -c '
import json, sys
report = json.load(open("packages/core/reports/mutation/fixture.json"))
mutants = report["files"]["fixtures/tolerance/detector.ts"]["mutants"]
for m in mutants:
    print(m["status"], m["mutatorName"], repr(m.get("replacement")))
killed = {(m["mutatorName"], m.get("replacement")) for m in mutants if m["status"] == "Killed"}
required = {
    ("EqualityOperator", "chargedCents <= expectedCents + toleranceCents"),
    ("ArithmeticOperator", "expectedCents - toleranceCents"),
}
survived = [m["id"] for m in mutants if m["status"] in ("Survived", "NoCoverage")]
missing = sorted(required - killed)
print("comparison-flipping and sign-flipping mutants killed:", not missing, "| survived:", survived)
sys.exit(1 if missing or survived else 0)
'
